kurals.tr: Anangukol Aaimayil Kollo Kananguzhai / Maadharkol Maalum En Nenju
kurals.m: Is this jewelled female a celestial, a choice peahen, or a human being ? My mind is perplexed

kurals.tr: Nokkinaal Nokkedhir Nokkudhal Thaakkanangu / Thaanaikkon Tanna Thutaiththu
kurals.m: This female beauty returning my looks is like a celestial maiden coming with an army to contend against me

kurals.tr: Pantariyen Kootren Padhanai Iniyarindhen / Pentakaiyaal Peramark Kattu
kurals.m: I never knew before what is called Yama; I see it now; it is the eyes that carry on a great fight with (the help of) female qualities

kurals.tr: Kantaar Uyirunnum Thotraththaal Pentakaip / Pedhaikku Amarththana Kan
kurals.m: These eyes that seem to kill those who look at them are as it were in hostilities with this feminine simplicity

kurals.tr: Kootramo Kanno Pinaiyo Matavaral / Nokkamim Moondrum Utaiththu
kurals.m: Is it Yama, (a pair of) eyes or a hind ?- Are not all these three in the looks of this maid ?

kurals.tr: Kotumpuruvam Kotaa Maraippin Natungagnar / Seyyala Manival Kan
kurals.m: Her eyes will cause (me) no trembling sorrow, if they are properly hidden by her cruel arched eyebrows

kurals.tr: Kataaak Kalitrinmer Katpataam Maadhar / Pataaa Mulaimel Thukil
kurals.m: The cloth that covers the firm bosom of this maiden is (like) that which covers the eyes of a rutting elephant

kurals.tr: Onnudhar Koo Utaindhadhe Gnaatpinul / Nannaarum Utkumen Peetu
kurals.m: On her bright brow alone is destroyed even that power of mine that used to terrify the most fearless

kurals.tr: Pinaiyer Matanokkum Naanum Utaiyaatku / Aniyevano Edhila Thandhu
kurals.m: Of what use are other jewels to her who is adorned with modesty, and the meek looks of a hind ?

kurals.tr: Untaarkan Alladhu Atunaraak Kaamampol / Kantaar Makizhseydhal Indru
kurals.m: Unlike boiled honey which yields delight only when it is drunk, love gives pleasure even when looked at
